official.deadline_note: All submission elements - including the administrative and financial document signed and stamped by each partner institution - must be deposited electronically before 17 November 2026 at 11:00 Paris time. A webinar was held on 11 September 2026 and an FAQ document is published on the call page.
official.application_cycle: 2026 call (opened 21 July 2026 at 09:00 CEST; single-phase call)
official.status_note: The ANR call page shows the call as 'Ouvert' (open): it opened on 21 July 2026 at 09:00 CEST and project submission closes on 17 November 2026 at 11:00 CET. The call runs in a single phase - full proposals are submitted and evaluated by an international committee set up by the ANR.
official.funding_period: one-off grant per project (36-54 month projects)
benefits: A grant (dotation) of between 800 kEUR and 3 M EUR per project, disbursed by the ANR to the coordinating institution according to the schedule set in the aid contract
Total envelope of approximately 17.5 M EUR for this first PEPR GFM call, with no funding level privileged inside the 800 kEUR - 3 M EUR range
Eligible expenditure may finance equipment purchases and personnel expenditure specifically assigned to these projects, plus associated running costs, per the PEPR financial regulation
The AAP explicitly anticipates recruiting post-doctorants, doctoral students (doctorants) and technical staff on the project budget

Project running costs covered include the maturation phase, interaction with the PEPR GFM Scientific Council and Stakeholder and Citizen Forum, participation in PEPR GFM actions, the Data Management Plan, and travel connected with reducing the project's environmental footprint
eligibility: The coordinating institution must be a French higher education and research institution; the beneficiaries of the aid are research organisations and higher education and research institutions
Companies and foreign institutions may be associated as partners but cannot receive funding for that participation

Private institutions contributing to public-service missions in higher education and research under article L.732-1 of the Code de l'Education may be financed after ANR analysis, MESRE opinion and SGPI validation
The project must fit into one or several of the five PEPR GFM challenges (Defi 1 to Defi 5)
The project must require a wide interdisciplinary and/or transdisciplinary approach as defined in section 2.2 of the AAP
The project must have a duration of between 36 and 54 months, and the amount of aid requested must be between 0.8 M EUR and 3 M EUR

The submission file must be deposited complete on the ANR submission site before the published closing date and time, with the administrative and financial document signed and stamped by each partner institution
requirements: Obtain an account (login and password) on the ANR submission site in advance - the AAP recommends registering as early as possible

Deposit the complete submission file electronically from the project manager's account before the published closing date and time; only the electronic version present at the call closing time is taken into account for evaluation
The project scientific document must follow the template published on the call website and be deposited in unprotected PDF format, written in English, maximum 15 pages

Define a structured maturation phase at the start of the project with duration, budget and responsible persons, producing an operational roadmap, an ethical issues analysis, an internal ethics charter and a Data Management Plan
Designate a referent donnees responsible for the PGD, a referent des enjeux ethiques, and a person responsible for monitoring equity and inclusion

Justify in the project budget the participation of project leaders in two in-person meetings every 18 months in metropolitan France and 3-4 travels for workpackage leaders or staff in training every 2 years

Projects acquiring new data or samples at sea on unprogrammed French oceanographic fleet means must justify the need and follow the upstream operational feasibility study procedure, supplying the minutes of the ad hoc commission (CNFH or CNFC)
Data management must rely on the Research e-Infrastructures tools and services (Data-Terra, Huma-num, Progedo), following FAIR and, where relevant, CARE principles
documents: Scientific document (document scientifique): maximum 15 pages, written in English, on the published template, with the list of scientific publications of the last three years in appendix

Administrative and financial document (document administratif et financier): administrative and budget description integrating the commitment letters (lettres d'engagement) of the partner institutions, signed and stamped by each legal representative
Data Management Plan (Plan de Gestion de Donnees, PGD): first version within the six months following project start
Internal consortium ethics charter (charte ethique interne au consortium), written during the maturation phase
Minutes of the ad hoc commission (CNFH or CNFC) of the IR* Flotte evaluations, where a sea campaign on not-yet-programmed fleet means is integrated
Consortium agreement (accord de consortium), or a copy of an existing framework contract covering the same provisions, when required
selection_criteria: Only proposals satisfying the eligibility criteria (criteres de recevabilite) are transmitted to the evaluation committee and can be funded

Eligible projects are assessed by an independent international-dimension committee convened by the ANR, which may call on external experts and may hear project leaders after sending questions in advance
Evaluation criteria cover scientific ambition and excellence, the quality of the consortium, resources mobilised and governance, and fit with the PEPR GFM challenges and impact

Uninvolved PEPR GFM programme directors propose to the SGPI which projects could be financed and at what amount; the Prime Minister, after opinion of the CPMo and the SGPI, decides beneficiaries and amounts
coverage: Grant of between 800 kEUR and 3 M EUR per project, disbursed by the ANR to the coordinating institution according to the aid contract schedule
Total envelope of approximately 17.5 M EUR for this first PEPR GFM call
Eligible expenditure per the PEPR financial regulation: for example equipment purchases and personnel expenditure specifically assigned to these projects, plus associated running costs

Prepare the scientific document strictly on the published template, in English, 15 pages maximum, including the three-year publication list appendix
Collect the commitment letters of every partner institution, signed and stamped by the legal representative, and embed them in the administrative and financial document
Complete the administrative and financial Excel document (budget between 800 kEUR and 3 M EUR, duration between 36 and 54 months)
Upload both documents into the dedicated 'documents de depot' and 'documents signes' sections of the call entry on the submission site, well before the closing time
Validate the submission electronically before 17 November 2026 at 11:00 Paris time; an electronic acknowledgement of receipt is sent to the project manager
official.application_route: Electronic submission through the ANR submission site from the project manager's account, with the scientific document and the signed administrative and financial document deposited before the closing time.

official.description: The France 2030 PEPR 'Grands Fonds Marins' call for projects stimulates the creation of new wide-interdisciplinary and transdisciplinary research consortia on deep-sea environments, from the ocean floor and its subsoil to the water column below 200 metres. The call is a single phase, with projects of 36 to 54 months requesting 800 kEUR to 3 M EUR of ANR funding within a total envelope of approximately 17.5 M EUR, awarded to French higher education and research institutions.
official.program_type: Research grant (ANR / France 2030 priority research programme call)
official.english_requirement: The scientific document must be written in English (redige en anglais), maximum 15 pages, using the published template and deposited as an unprotected PDF

tuition_coverage, living_cost_coverage and travel_coverage (this is an institutional research grant; no student scholarships, tuition waivers, living allowances or travel grants are paid to individuals)

applicant_utility.summary: This is consortium funding for institutions, not a personal scholarship: the money goes to a coordinating French higher education or research institution, companies and foreign partners join without funding, and any doctoral or post-doctoral positions are salaried jobs on the project budget rather than scholarships. The design constraints are strict - 36 to 54 months, 800 kEUR to 3 M EUR requested, English scientific document on the mandatory template capped at 15 pages - and the evaluation rewards genuinely wide interdisciplinary or transdisciplinary breadth, so a consortium that merely adds one humanities partner to a geology project will read thin. Build in the required maturation phase with its roadmap, ethics analysis and internal ethics charter, name your data and ethics referents at submission, and collect every partner's signed and stamped commitment letter well before 17 November 2026 at 11:00 Paris time, because only the complete file sitting on the submission site at closing counts.
applicant_utility.best_fit: A permanent researcher or teacher-researcher at a French higher education or research institution who can coordinate a 36-54 month, wide-interdisciplinary deep-sea consortium and needs ANR funding of 800 kEUR - 3 M EUR including doctoral and post-doctoral positions.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm the project maps onto at least one of the five PEPR GFM challenges and can defend its interdisciplinary or transdisciplinary claim under section 2.2 of the AAP
Size the budget inside 800 kEUR - 3 M EUR with an explicit justification - no level inside the range is favoured, but the sizing must match the consortium and its staffing
Register on the ANR submission site early and test the upload sections before the final week
Draft the scientific document on the published template, in English, within 15 pages, including the three-year publication list appendix
Collect signed and stamped commitment letters from every partner for the administrative and financial document
Budget for the compulsory in-person meetings (two every 18 months in metropolitan France) and the 3-4 travels every two years for workpackage leaders and staff in training
common_rejection_risks: A file that is incomplete at the closing time - only the electronic version present at closing is evaluated
Exceeding the 15-page scientific limit or departing from the template
A consortium that claims interdisciplinarity without a shared scientific question integrating conceptual frameworks
Missing the maturation phase, ethics analysis, internal ethics charter or Data Management Plan design, all of which are evaluation criteria
No named referent donnees, referent des enjeux ethiques or equity-and-inclusion monitor at submission
Requesting aid outside the 800 kEUR - 3 M EUR range or proposing a project shorter than 36 or longer than 54 months
Sea campaigns on unprogrammed fleet means without the upstream feasibility study and CNFH/CNFC commission minutes
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The grant pays the project's eligible costs (equipment, assigned personnel, running costs) to the coordinating institution; anything outside the eligible-expenditure framework - and any participation by companies or foreign institutions - is not funded by this call.
document_audit: The administrative and financial document must contain every partner's commitment letter signed and stamped by the legal representative - chase these early, they are the classic last-minute failure
The scientific document must be an unprotected PDF in English on the published template, with the publications appendix
If a sea campaign is planned, the ad hoc commission minutes (CNFH or CNFC) are part of the file
A consortium agreement is needed only in defined cases, but where required it must reach the ANR within 12 months of the aid contract - its absence can stop funding and trigger repayment
alerts: This is a one-off exceptional grant distinct from recurrent institutional funding, intended for new actions

Beneficiaries must guarantee immediate open access to peer-reviewed publications under CC-BY, deposit the accepted manuscript in HAL, deliver a first PGD within six months, and deposit data in a thematic repository or recherche.data.gouv
Communications must mention France 2030 support and use its logos, and annual indicator reporting to the State and ANR is mandatory

The aid may constitute State aid and is subject to the French research State-aid framework, the RDI exemption regime, the de-minimis Regulation and the 2011/20/EU decision - check your institution's cumulative aid position before sizing the request
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Single-phase electronic submission on the ANR site (scientific document plus signed administrative and financial document) before 17 November 2026 at 11:00 Paris time; eligibility screening, then evaluation by the ANR-convened international committee with possible hearings; programme directors propose to the SGPI and the Prime Minister decides beneficiaries and amounts.
